entities.name: Old PDU session ID
entities.description: Information element included by UE in UL NAS TRANSPORT message when transporting PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST after receiving PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND with specific conditions.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message used to transport PDU session establishment request.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message
entities.description: 5GSM message transported within UL NAS TRANSPORT message for PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message
entities.description: Downlink message that triggers the UE to send PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST with old PDU session ID.

entities.name: 5GSM cause IE set to #39
entities.description: Condition where 5GSM cause information element is set to value #39 indicating 'reactivation requested'.

entities.name: Payload container type IE set to N1 SM information
entities.description: Condition where payload container type information element is set to 'N1 SM information'.

relations.description: UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Old PDU session ID IE under specific conditions.
UL NAS TRANSPORT message transports PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.
Inclusion of Old PDU session ID IE is guarded by condition that PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND had 5GSM cause IE set to #39.
Inclusion of Old PDU session ID IE is guarded by condition that payload container type IE is set to 'N1 SM information'.
